rule: While unvalidated records are at least half of the catalog, the catalog may not grow past catalogCeiling. Validating tabs lifts the pause; removing or merging a tab is always allowed. tools/lint.js enforces this while paused is true.
unpaused: 2026-09-26, by the owner's decision: new tabs may be added while most records are unvalidated; each still starts unvalidated with its own record. Set paused to true to restore the ceiling.
why: A research user trusts the weakest tab they happen to open. See docs/RESEARCH-GRADE.md, section 6.
